Description

Earth Observation (EO) and Automatic Identification Systems (AIS) applications.

This project marks a vital milestone in ANGKASA-X’s endeavor to deploy a constellation of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites in the near future, which will be developed and assembled in Malaysia, solidifying the nation’s role as a significant player in the global space industry and the space tech ecosystem.
Notes

The news said designed in Malaysia, but the manufacturer is assumed to be SPUTNIX due to the similar looks of other Sputnix satellites and there is also the name Sputnix on the solar panels.
